candidateFeature.broaderContext: Limbones Cove / Barangay Sta. Mercedes coastal area

question: Do official Cavite ecological profiles provide site-specific fish evidence for a Maragondon coastal reef that can safely enter the Bangwit species ledger?

sources.title: Cavite Ecological Profile 2018, Chapter 2
sources.location: PDF text, lines 331-333; coastal resources / coral reefs
sources.sourceReported: The profile locates coral reef sites at Sitio Pinagkainan and Patungan, Barangay Sta. Mercedes, Maragondon, and says a school of fusiliers (Caesio spp.) was observed at Sitio Patungan Munti. It also reports that about 40% of the species belonged to Pomacentridae and Labridae, without a species list.
sources.sourceDateNotes: The coral-area paragraph says mapping was conducted as of 2013. The fish observation date is not stated and is not assigned to 2013.

sources.title: Cavite Ecological Profile 2021
sources.location: PDF text, lines 2736-2751; coral reef and seagrass passages
sources.sourceReported: Repeats the Patungan Munti passage, including the genus-level Caesio spp. observation. It is treated as a profile re-publication, not an independent fish survey.

sources.title: Bataan-Cavite Interlink Bridge Environmental Impact Assessment Report
sources.location: PDF text, lines 9292-9300; environmental critical areas discussion
sources.sourceReported: The EIA repeats the 19.26 ha coral-reef context and the same Patungan Munti Caesio spp. observation. It is treated as a copied secondary reference, not an independent fish survey or a station-level survey result.

sources.title: Cavite Ecological Profile 2024
sources.location: PDF text, lines 2009-2012; coastal resources / coral reefs
sources.sourceReported: Repeats the same source-named Patungan Munti observation and Caesio spp. genus-level label. The profile separately says 2022 coral-reef status for Maragondon municipal waters was for assessment; this does not update the historical fish observation or establish present reef condition.

interpretation.observationType: historical source-reported observation of a school; not an itemized specimen or occurrence checklist
interpretation.localityStrength: named site Patungan Munti under the Maragondon / Sta. Mercedes coastal-reef discussion; no coordinates or survey-station crosswalk

limitations: No collection/observation date, fish-survey protocol, effort, observer, specimen or image vouchers, or species-level identification is supplied in the reviewed passages.
The reported family percentage does not provide family member taxa or a complete fish checklist.
The named reef context is not Maragondon River Estuary; do not transfer this observation to the estuary or river channel.
No exact reef feature boundary, coordinates, salinity measurements, current-presence evidence, catchability, diet, safety, or fishing-rule evidence is provided.
The official profile has no item-specific data-reuse license verified for public app republication.
nextAction: Locate the underlying PENRO/BFAR reef fish survey or an independently reviewable site-specific dataset. Confirm site identity and field date, fish visual-census method, taxon identification/voucher support, spatial relationship to any protected reef, and item-specific reuse terms before creating a scope feature or species record. Keep the coastal reef candidate separate from Maragondon River and its estuary.
